title: Focus Active Window Engagement Input
description: When a window is active and has engagement, auto-focus the engagement input. Fix CAD play typing hitting all panes (global key capture + replIsQueryTypingTarget). Wire window activation to focus model definition.
summary: Engagement hover uses a full-width top strip (h-large, z-panel, pointer-events-auto) so the interaction reveals when the mouse enters the top of the window, not only a small top-left box. Fixed pointer-events toggling that dismissed chrome on expand; popover/engagement leave handling preserved.
